Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished, independently proposed automotive dealer logo for Edinburgh Van Sales (Broxburn). This is a first proposal, not a claim of an official adopted identity.
Asset type: genuinely transparent raster logo for web headers and a matching compact favicon.
Composition: horizontal lockup, visually balanced. Put ONLY the isolated compact emblem on the left, approximately the left 28 percent; keep a completely empty transparent vertical gap at least 9 percent of total width between emblem and wordmark, so the emblem can be extracted losslessly. The emblem is a compact distinctive EV monogram with a single broad roof line suggesting a panel van; form a nearly square solid emblem, simple open counters and thick strokes readable at 32 pixels, no elaborate van illustration. Its visible geometry should be as wide as it is tall, with thick clean edges and no tiny loose details. On the right, set the exact business text in bold crisp modern sans-serif, balanced across the following lines:
EDINBURGH
VAN SALES
(BROXBURN)
Typography: exact spelling and punctuation; substantial readable letterforms, open counters, no thin subtitle. No slogans, dates, badge claims, URLs or other text.
Color: solid deep ink #101820 throughout the emblem and lettering, intended to be highly legible on white. No gradients, metallic finish, shadows, glows, texture or faint outlines.
Background: real transparent alpha, no white rectangle or checkerboard painted into the artwork. Smooth clean antialiased edges, opaque solid interiors, zero haze or translucent halo. Keep margins modest. One logo only, no mockup, no scene, no border around the canvas. Preserve the separate emblem and clear transparent gap.
